column1: # Transport master / status list. One row per transporter name as it appears in the search results.
#   status must be exactly "Active" or "Not Active".
#   Not Active transporters are never returned by the API or shown in the table.
#   Names match exactly (case/spacing ignored): "DTDC" and "DTDC Transport" are separate transporters.
#   A transporter with NO row here is treated as Active (setting: UNLISTED_TRANSPORT_STATUS).
#   Changes are picked up automatically; no restart needed.
# No statuses are pre-filled on purpose: add a row only for transporters whose status you know
